title.narrative: The Ministry of Education (MoE) prioritized education management through funding from the Global Partnership for Education (GPE), to strengthen evidence-based decision making. In collaboration with the MoE and the Secondary Students Board (CESB), UNICEF facilitated the launch of the Student Government Regulation, approved in 2023. Additionally, CESB students received support to actively participate in the Education Congress, fostering adolescent engagement.
